findings.ac: nw worker ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands
findings.title: Allowed-command tests patch own_nw as well as execvp
findings.detail: test_allowed_commands_are_execd replaces both os.execvp and W.own_nw, so in that test the exec target is fixed. Separate tests (test_own_nw_execs_the_forced_command_path, test_own_nw_never_uses_the_client_path) cover own_nw on its own, so the AC is still covered. Nothing checks the two together.
findings.suggested_fix: In tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py, add one case that patches only os.execvp and sets sys.argv[0] to an executable tmp `nw`, then asserts the exec argv is [that path, 'worker', 'info'].
findings.acceptance: The new test passes and fails if ssh_command execs the client-supplied words[0].

findings.title: Scope beyond the spec is documented but not small
findings.detail: Several things the spec did not ask for were shipped: signal handling (SIGTERM/INT/HUP with a stage 'signal'), a jobs.lock, stale git lock cleanup, an `errors` key with exit 1 for gc, `have` refreshing refs, and the `remote:` slot prefix. All of them are recorded in 'As shipped' and are reasonable hardening, but they make this worker larger than the Design described.
findings.suggested_fix: No code change needed. Make sure SPEC-0337 and SPEC-0338 refer to the shipped `remote:<campaign>` slot id and the gc `errors` exit code.
findings.acceptance: SPEC-0338's dispatch design names the `remote:` prefix and the error stages read/slot/signal.

ac_assessment.ac: Valid header+bundle runs gates and emits accepted, started, gate (with .log/.json/.r<n>), done
ac_assessment.evidence: worker.gate_job/_run_gates/gate_files. test_pass_emits_frames_and_files asserts the frame types are [accepted, started, gate, done] and the files are {001-hello.log, 001-hello.json}. test_retry_ladder_sends_r1_files asserts the .r1.log and .r1.json files arrive.

ac_assessment.ac: git merge-base $NW_BASE HEAD on the worker prints the coordinator's sha
ac_assessment.evidence: _checkout creates refs/heads/<name> and refs/remotes/origin/<rest>. test_merge_base_and_base_placeholder_match_the_coordinator compares the worker's output with the local merge-base. test_origin_base_name_resolves_like_a_remote_tracking_branch covers an origin/main base.

ac_assessment.ac: An env key outside the allowlist gives a validate error and nothing runs; a reused job_id gives a claim error
ac_assessment.evidence: validate_header checks against ENV_ALLOWLIST, and the mkdir claim in gate_job refuses an existing dir. test_env_outside_allowlist_is_refused checks that no marker file and no job dir exist and that the only frame is error. test_duplicate_job_id_is_a_claim_error covers the claim case.

ac_assessment.ac: Two concurrent jobs with different base.sha for the same base.name each see their own base
ac_assessment.evidence: Each job gets a private `git clone --shared` with its own refs. test_concurrent_jobs_see_their_own_base syncs the two gates so they run at the same time, with slots: 2, and asserts each rev-parse output equals that job's own base.

ac_assessment.ac: EOF mid-gate kills the gate and gives done interrupted; EOF during the slot wait gives done interrupted with no started
ac_assessment.evidence: _watch_stdin sets cancel and calls terminate_all. test_eof_mid_gate_interrupts checks by pid that the sleep is gone. test_eof_while_waiting_for_the_slot asserts there is no started frame, no gate frame and no marker file.

ac_assessment.ac: With the slot held, slot_wait comes first, then started once the slot frees
ac_assessment.evidence: test_held_slot_gives_slot_wait_then_started holds GS.acquire, asserts no started frame while it is held, then checks the types are [accepted, slot_wait, started, gate, done]. The waiter is remote:C-1.

ac_assessment.ac: Exit 0 after done (pass/fail/interrupted), exit 3 after error
ac_assessment.evidence: Exit 0: test_fail_is_done_with_ok_false_and_exit_0, test_pass and the EOF/signal tests. Exit 3: the env refusal, bad header and read error tests.

ac_assessment.ac: A log over 16 MiB is cut to 16 MiB with truncated_bytes in its sidecar
ac_assessment.evidence: _file_payload/gate_files. test_log_over_16_mib_is_truncated asserts len == MAX_LOG_BYTES, that the tail marker is kept and the head marker is gone, and that truncated_bytes is exact.

ac_assessment.ac: have reports commit and base after the job; gc --keep-days 0 removes the refs, objects and job dirs; a live job's dir survives
ac_assessment.evidence: test_have_then_gc_removes_refs_objects_and_job_dirs checks that have lists both shas, then after gc that have lists none, cat-file -e fails and the job dir is gone. test_gc_during_a_live_job_keeps_its_dir checks the live job's tree and its objects survive.

ac_assessment.ac: nw worker info --json prints the documented keys
ac_assessment.evidence: test_info_json_keys asserts the exact key set and the schema and protocol values.

ac_assessment.ac: ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands and refuses everything else with exit 2
ac_assessment.evidence: check_ssh_command has a literal grammar. test_allowed_commands_are_execd covers 6 forms. test_refused_commands_run_nothing covers 25 refusals, including `nw queue run`, `--repo ../x`, metacharacters and an empty command, each with exit 2, execvp never called and `refused:` on stderr.

ac_assessment.ac: docs/WORKFLOW.md documents the mandatory dedicated user and the absolute-path key line
ac_assessment.evidence: The diff adds a 'Remote gate worker' section with a threat model, 'all of it is mandatory', a dedicated unprivileged user and the key line `command="/home/user/.local/bin/nw worker ssh-command",restrict`. test_workflow_docs_make_the_dedicated_user_mandatory_and_show_the_key_line checks it.
